{{Quote|My father was a personal attache to the household of one of the head Muun families.|[[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] on his father|<ref name="The Rise of Clovis" />}}
'''Rush Clovis's father''' served as the personal attache of one of the head [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] families in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. When his son, [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], was twelve, he, his wife, and the wife of the head Muun [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] accident, leaving a young Clovis to be adopted by the Muun family.<ref name="The Rise of Clovis" />
